summary: Vidu's AI video platform hands new users trial credits at registration and keeps topping them up through daily login bonuses, letting you generate text-to-video and image-to-video clips without paying. Credits can also be earned through official events. The current Free plan does not permit commercial use and does not provide watermark-free downloads. No fixed signup or daily credit quantity is stated in the current pricing FAQ.
claim_steps: Register a free account at vidu.com.
Receive the sign-up trial credits automatically.
Log in daily to collect bonus credits.
Spend credits on text-to-video or image-to-video generations.

Use Free outputs noncommercially and expect watermarked downloads; paid tiers add commercial-use and watermark-free features. Check your actual available credits rather than assuming a published fixed grant.

social_proof.title: Vidu pricing FAQ — free-credit sources
social_proof.text: Sign-up Bonus: New users receive trial credits upon registering for Vidu. Daily Login: Earn credits by logging in every day.
